description: Defence Airfields - Australian Noise Exposure Forecast (ANEF) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Defence. Australian Defence Airfields ANEF ANEC Development - Australian Noise Exposure Forecast (ANEF). (Ref: defence. gov. au/AircraftNoise/Default. asp) Homeowners should be familiar with their local Australian Noise Exposure Forecast (ANEF) maps, which provide the best information about aircraft noise exposure near Defence bases. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Defence. Its tags are Boundaries, Defence, Location, airfields, noise. It offers 1 resource(s) in kml. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
